articles.title: Rajnath Singh unveils landmark policy reforms for ICG personnel and their families
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh recently unveiled two significant policy reforms for the Indian Coast Guard. These initiatives aim to promote gender parity in the induction and service conditions, ensuring equal opportunities for women. This move reflects a commitment to fostering a more inclusive and diverse workforce within the ICG, strengthening women's role in national defence and maritime security.

articles.title: What is the highest acceleration a human can survive?
articles.summary: Humans can survive remarkably high g-forces, or multiples of Earth’s gravitational acceleration, but duration, direction, and application are critical. This scientific understanding is vital for fields like aerospace and defence, ensuring safety and performance for pilots and astronauts. The ability to withstand extreme acceleration is key to designing high-performance aircraft and spacecraft, considering human physiological limits.

articles.title: How one Karnataka village's traditional diet is linked to healthy child growth
articles.summary: Children in a village within Karnataka's Uttara Kannada district are demonstrating exceptional growth, mirroring the health outcomes seen in India's most affluent households. This significant development suggests effective local health and nutrition initiatives are bridging socioeconomic gaps, potentially offering a model for improving child welfare across rural India and highlighting successful grassroots efforts.

articles.title: Apollo Micro Systems shortlisted by IAF for indigenous prescision range extension kit programme
articles.summary: Apollo Micro Systems (AMS) has been selected by the Indian Air Force to develop the Indigenous Precision Range Extension Kit (IPREK). This critical defence technology programme aims to significantly improve IAF capabilities, reinforcing India's push for self-reliance in advanced military systems. The collaboration underscores the 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiative, enhancing indigenous defence manufacturing and strategic independence for the nation.

articles.title: Tejas Shirse battles stress fracture to make historic Commonwealth Games final
articles.summary: Indian hurdler Tejas Shirse created history at the Commonwealth Games, becoming the first from the country to reach the men's 110m hurdles final. While achieving this significant milestone, his journey was marked by both breakthrough and disappointment, reflecting the high stakes and challenges of elite international competition. This performance highlights India's growing presence in global athletics.

articles.title: DRDO sensitive data offered for sale on dark web for nearly Rs 8 lakh
articles.summary: Alleged DRDO data, including sensitive information, has reportedly surfaced on the dark web and is being offered for sale for $8,000, as claimed by a Kerala-based cyber intelligence firm. DRDO is actively verifying the authenticity of this potential data breach. This incident highlights a significant cyber security concern for India's premier defence research organization and critical national assets.

articles.title: Shirse's Courageous CWG Final Run On Injured Foot
articles.summary: Indian national record-holder Tejas Shirse displayed extraordinary courage and determination by competing in the Commonwealth Games men's 110m hurdles final despite a stress fracture. He made history as the first Indian to reach this final, inspiring many with his unwavering spirit and commitment to represent the nation even amidst significant personal challenge, embodying true resilience.

articles.title: BTEUP Even Semester result 2026 declared at bteup.ac.in: Direct link active to download marksheet
articles.summary: The Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh (BTEUP) has declared the results for its Even Semester examinations for 2026. Students can now access and download their marksheets directly from the official website, bteup.ac.in. This announcement is significant for those awaiting their academic performance from the technical education board, ensuring timely access to their results.
